Once that’s done, create a trip booking and shopping summary for traveler_user_id user_01 and send me an in-app alert. Finally, look up alice in the company directory, email her that the trip summary is ready, and also send her a high-priority app alert saying the travel itinerary, hotel archive, and shopping recommendation have been prepared.
